artworks.title: Piercing of Christ's Side
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. Three crosses are depicted on a hill, with figures around them in various poses. The lines are finely etched to create detailed textures in the figures’ robes and the clouds in the sky. The scene emphasizes the middle cross, with surrounding figures adding depth to the composition. Contrast between light and shadow intensifies the emotional impact of the scene.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a platform inside a cave. The scene depicts cloaked figures lowering or lifting another figure lying on a stone platform with draped fabric. The cave interior features rock formations and stairs leading upwards on the right. Torches held by two figures illuminate the scene, casting shadows on the cave walls. The composition focuses on the central platform, with surrounding figures creating a sense of solemnity and focus. The drawing uses intricate lines to create depth and texture, adding dimensionality to the cave and the figures within it.

artworks.title: The Body of Christ being Covered with Flowersand Perfume
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving large jars. The image shows a group of figures engaged in an activity with large vessels. The setting appears to be indoors or in a cave, with one figure carrying a large jar down stairs. The composition suggests an ancient or classical scene. The figures are dressed in robes, and the setting is detailed with textured shading, creating an atmosphere of labor and cooperation.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: The etching shows a central figure standing or floating with arms open wide. The figure has long hair and a beard and is only partially clad with a draped cloth. Rays of light emanate outward around the figure. On the left side, a stone slab is being moved by two winged figures. On the right, several people are depicted, including one holding a shield, another pair engaged in a pushing motion. The background includes detailed line work creating cloud or smoke effects and trees positioned to the upper right.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to His Disciples
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an interior setting. The scene depicts several figures gathered around an open book on a central structure within the room. The central figure stands with their arm outstretched while other figures are seated or kneeling nearby. The room features patterned panels and a large curtain on the right side. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching and line work.

artworks.title: The Incredulity of Thomas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered in a classical architectural setting. The scene is set in a space with columns and a coffered ceiling. At the center of the composition is a figure with a radiant halo, standing on a platform and surrounded by others. The figures are dressed in robes, and some are gesturing towards the central figure or appear to be in conversation with them. The use of lines and shading imbue the image with a sense of depth. The figures on either side seem to react with expressions of wonder or discussion. The architectural elements frame the scene, focusing the viewer's attention on the central gathering.

artworks.title: The Ascension
artworks.description: The image shows a figure ascending in a celestial scene. The central figure is floating in the sky, surrounded by radiant light beams behind the clouds. The sky is filled with swirling cloud patterns. Below, there are figures on the ground in poses of awe and contemplation, with arms raised upwards. The composition conveys upward motion and divine presence, with contrast between the bright light in the sky and the shaded figures on the ground.

artworks.title: Bust of a Cook with Cap
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person positioned slightly turned to the side but looking directly at the viewer. The person has prominent facial features with a beard and mustache, and is wearing a cap. The clothing is a loose-fitting, buttoned garment. The background is a textured dark shading, highlighting the figure's face and attire. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Bust of a Man with Thick Lips
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's upper body from an angled side profile. The person is facing slightly to the left, with his head turned in that direction. He has distinct facial features like a prominent nose, full lips, a beard covering his chin and jawline, and closely cropped hair that transitions into a cap or head covering. He is wearing textured clothing. The background consists of intersecting lines creating a textured, hatched effect. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands or on his person.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Woman Turned in Profile to  the Right
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and upper torso. They are seated, facing to the right, with their arms likely resting in front of them. They are wearing a bonnet or hood and layered clothing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Juno in a Chariot Pulled by Peacocks
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures with peacocks. The scene depicts a seated figure on a chariot being pulled by two peacocks. One figure extends a hand towards the other figure who stands to the right holding a staff. The background features lines suggesting a rainbow or celestial elements. The drawing has detailed textures and forms, conveying motion and interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: Triumphant Christ with Prophets and Saints
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene inside a circular frame. The image depicts a central figure standing and receiving attention from surrounding figures. Around the main scene, intricate lettering encircles the frame, with ornate details and patterns filling the space. Rays of light and symbolic imagery appear in the background, emanating from above the central figure. The style of linework and design suggests an influence of medieval religious art.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man (Le Doreur)
artworks.artist: Léopold Flameng, after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man in a three-quarter view facing right. He has facial hair, a large, wide-brimmed hat covering his head, and wears a formal outfit with a thickly pleated, white ruffled collar and a dark cloak or robe over his shoulders. The background is a textured surface, and the borders of the image resemble the margin of a print or etching.

artworks.title: Sheet with Flower and Diamond Pattern
artworks.description: This is a painting of a patterned surface with floral motifs. It features a worn and aged piece of material with a repeating pattern of simple, stylized six-petal flowers enclosed within squares on a brown and cream background. The edges of the material are irregular and torn.

artworks.title: Sheet with Flower and Diamond Pattern
artworks.description: This is an image showing a piece of patterned paper or textile. The fragment displays a regular geometric pattern with flowers within diamond shapes. The shapes are arranged in a diagonal grid across the fragment. Each diamond contains a stylized flower, creating a consistent and repetitive visual theme. The paper or textile appears aged with tattered and uneven edges. The background is beige-toned, implying it is a historical piece. The pattern is drawn in dark ink, contrasting with the lighter background.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various decorative motifs and possibly early playing card designs. The drawing features panels filled with different ornamental patterns, including stylized plant forms that resemble floral or tree shapes. Some sections have symmetrical arrangements that look like simplified botanical illustrations, while one panel features a reclining figure depicted in a naive style. The paper appears old and there is tearing around the edges. The line work is relatively simple, with thin, dark lines that contrast with the beige background of the paper.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: The image shows a design fragment with botanical motifs, including three vertically arranged acorn-like formations flanking a leafy stem in the center. The color palette is warm and subdued, with a beige background and dark gray line work. The objects are aligned vertically in the center of the image, with torn and uneven edges.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: The image displays geometric shapes and lines arranged in a grid pattern. It features heart-shaped patterns stacked vertically within rectangular sections, alongside circular forms with intricate details to the right. The design appears repetitive and structured, reminiscent of playing cards or vintage botanical illustrations.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a patterned design on a piece of paper. The drawing consists of rectangular and square sections with simple motifs like leaves, hearts, and floral designs. The paper is worn with frayed edges, yellowing, and stains. The motifs are outlined in faded ink.

artworks.title: Sheet with Flower and Diamond Pattern
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a repeating floral geometric pattern. The image features a symmetrical arrangement of florals formed within a diamond grid pattern. Each diamond contains a flower with a central circle surrounded by petals, all outlined in dark ink against an aged, tan paper. The design appears to be drawn with precision. The edges of the paper are worn and tattered.

artworks.title: Sheet with Flower and Diamond Pattern
artworks.description: The image shows a repeating pattern of diamond shapes in a grid, with each diamond containing a flower-like design made up of circular forms and petal-like shapes. The arrangement creates an abstract tapestry-like pattern reminiscent of tilework or textile designs.

artworks.title: Holy Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures. The drawing is executed in a loose, expressive style with dark lines and a monochromatic color scheme, using shades of brown. The figures are outlined in a rough, gestural manner, suggesting movement and a sense of dynamic interaction among them. The scene appears to be intimate, with the figures gathered closely together, focusing on the central figure that appears to embrace or support another figure. The simplicity and fluidity of lines create a harmonious composition, highlighting the emotional intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: Le Petit Chasseur (Little Hunter)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane W. Atlas
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a row of trees on the horizon under a setting or rising sun. Delicate strokes are used, particularly for the trees and vegetation. The color palette is muted with mainly sepia and brown tones. In the foreground, a figure and a dog walk along a path leading towards the trees.

artworks.title: Premiere promenade de Berlin
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a detailed outdoor scene with people in a park setting. The point of view is at eye level, providing a comprehensive view. Tall trees frame the scene, with intricate leaf details. The horizon line is slightly above the center, with a statue and more trees in the distance. The engraving features precise lines capturing textures of leaves, fabric, and stone. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. Figures are shown strolling in the park, with some engaging in conversation. A wooden trellis is visible in the background.
